events.title: Psychological First Aid 4 Module Course
events.description:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Flourishing Hub, IIT Bombay.

We are pleased to invite you to a 4-module workshop series on Psychological First Aid.

This course will equip students to identify signs of psychological distress, respond compassionately, support immediate safety and connect peers with appropriate professional resources. It does not train participants to diagnose psychological disorders or provide counselling.



The workshop series will cover:

* Module 1: Recognise Psychological Distress - 6th Oct 2026, Tuesday

Understand common psychological concerns experienced in demanding academic environments. Recognise emotional, cognitive, behavioural, physical, academic and social signs of distress. Understand how academic pressure, perfectionism, comparison, isolation and personal difficulties contribute to distress. Differentiate temporary stress from persistent or escalating concerns.



* Module 2:  Suicide Prevention & Crisis Response - 13th Oct 2026, Tuesday



Understand the nature of suicidal distress. Recognise suicide risk factors and warning signs. Learn how to ask directly and sensitively about suicidal thoughts. Understand the immediate actions required during a crisis.



* Module 3:  Stabilise Distress & Strengthen Coping - 21st Oct 2026, Wednesday



 Understand how distress affects thoughts, emotions, bodily responses and behaviour. Recognise avoidance, perfectionism, overwork and other unhelpful coping cycles. Learn brief grounding and emotional-regulation strategies.Help a distressed person identify manageable next steps.



 * Module 4: Providing Psychological First Aid - 27th Oct 2026, Tuesday



Develop practical skills for approaching and supporting a distressed person. Practise active listening, empathy and validation. Apply the Psychological First Aid framework of Look, Listen and Link. Understand confidentiality, role boundaries, referral and supporter well-being.



Workshop Details

📅 Date: Module 1- 6th Oct 2026, Tuesday

Module 2 - 13th Oct 2026, Tuesday

Module 3- 21st Oct 2026, Wednesday

Module 4- 27th Oct 2026, Tuesday

🕙 Time: 6.30 pm - 8.00 pm

📍 Venue: LT 303

In case of any queries please write to us at flourishing@iitbfh.com.

Best regards,

Flourishing Hub Team

events.description:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Flourishing Hub, IIT Bombay.

In a world of constant notifications, social media, and competing demands for our attention, staying focused has become increasingly challenging. How can we understand the ways in which digital distractions affect our attention, and develop the ability to concentrate on what truly matters?

The Flourishing Hub invites you to Mastering Your Attention: From Distraction to Concentration, an interactive workshop by Mr. Dnyaneshwar Nerkar, International Trainer, Digital Wellness & Focus Evangelist.

The session will explore the relationship between digital distractions, social media, and our ability to concentrate, while introducing practical perspectives on developing focused attention.

Impact of Social Media: Why It Is Addictive

events.title: Student Workshop - Emotional Fitness course
events.description:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Flourishing Hub, IIT Bombay.

We are pleased to invite you to a 4-module workshop series on Emotional Fitness.

This practical, skills-based series will help you develop a healthier and more effective relationship with your emotions through reflection, experiential activities, and practical tools that can be applied to everyday life

The workshop series will cover:

Module 1: Understanding Emotions- 7th Oct 2026

Learn to recognise, understand, and accurately label your emotions, while exploring what emotions signal and how they influence your responses.

Module 2: Emotional Regulation- 14th Oct 2026

Understand your emotional triggers, manage emotional intensity, tolerate discomfort, and respond without impulsive reactions or suppression.

Module 3: Building Positive Emotional Fitness-21st Oct 2026

Explore ways to cultivate positive emotions through savouring, strengths, meaningful relationships, and everyday practices.

Module 4: Applying Emotional Fitness- 28th Oct 2026

Develop emotional flexibility, communicate emotions effectively, navigate interpersonal situations, and create your own emotional fitness toolkit.

Learn how to notice, understand, regulate, and respond to them more skillfully.

We’re excited to announce that registrations for **Beginner and Advanced Calisthenics classes** are now open!

Calisthenics is a form of strength and fitness training that primarily uses bodyweight as resistance. The sessions focus on developing **strength, mobility, flexibility, endurance, balance, and body control** through progressive training and skill-based exercises.

### **Details of the sessions:**

**Date:** Starting from 16th September, 2026
**Venue:** Screening Room, 3rd Floor (New SAC, opp. Hostel-11)
**Days:** Mon-Wed-Fri (3 sessions/week)

**Advanced Calisthenics:** 8:30 - 9:30 pm
**Registration Link:** https://forms.gle/tmyEiSLxJqY55FpB9

### **Advanced Calisthenics – Training Focus**

The advanced sessions will focus on progressive development of:

1. Hand Balancing & Handstand
2. Headstand
3. Upper-body strength & endurance
4. Push-up variations
5. Pistol Squats
6. Side Splits & Front Splits
7. Running & endurance training
8. Other progressive calisthenics skills and movements

**Deadline to register:** 15th September, 2026, 11:59 PM

1. Sessions will begin promptly at the scheduled time. No late entries or extended sessions.
